name: Video Email for Gmail™ by cloudHQ
description:
Seeking to make your emails more engaging?

Or perhaps your schedule is too packed to craft an email, but a video message sounds perfect?

Video Email offers a completely free solution, enabling you to record a video, apply various filters, and send it directly via Gmail with just three simple steps: record, upload, and send.

Additionally, you can choose to privately upload your video to YouTube, Google Drive, or save it as a video file to attach to your email.

This tool is perfect for sales professionals, real estate agents, lawyers, marketers, and anyone looking to rise above the mundane text email clutter.

cloudHQ. Empowering your communications.
